svg.title: G0 Governance: integrated process map
svg.desc: Process map of phase G0 Governance: GOV-01 Impact analysis of the inherited Asimov v1 baseline and the concept-phase package (Joint, after nothing); GOV-02 Assurance strategy and lifecycle tailoring (Joint, after GOV-01); GOV-03 Regulatory conformity strategy (Joint, after GOV-02); GOV-04 Functional safety plan (Risk assessment, after GOV-03); GOV-05 Organisation rules, safety culture and competence (Joint, after GOV-04); GOV-06 Quality management and QA plan (Joint, after GOV-05); GOV-07 Confirmation measures plan (Risk assessment, after GOV-06); GOV-08 Cybersecurity plan (Cybersecurity, after GOV-05); GOV-09 Machine-learning safety plan (Machine learning, after GOV-08); GOV-10 Upstream and supplier management (Joint, after GOV-02); GOV-11 Configuration management plan and safety-relevant file list (Joint, after GOV-04, GOV-10); GOV-12 Change management (Joint, after GOV-11); GOV-13 Problem resolution (Joint, after GOV-12); GOV-14 Documentation management (Joint, after GOV-11); GOV-15 Verification and review procedure (Joint, after GOV-07, GOV-14); GOV-16 Requirements management and traceability procedure (Joint, after GOV-15); GOV-17 Project risk management (Joint, after GOV-04); GOV-18 Project plan (Joint, after GOV-07, GOV-17); GOV-19 Process capability baseline (Joint, after GOV-13, GOV-15); GOV-20 Work product register (Joint, after GOV-07); GOV-21 Integrated process model and maps (Joint, after GOV-20).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
